turns.content: How do I add a section view through the lobby?

From the help topic "Create a section view": select View > Section, then select two points across the lobby in a plan view. Drag the arrows to set how deep the view goes. The section appears under Sections in the Project Browser.
Delete all the unused families in this model.
I found 43 unused families, about 18 MB. Purging removes them from this model. Want me to go ahead?
Yes, go ahead.
I removed 43 unused families from the model. To reverse it, select Undo (Ctrl+Z) before you close the file.
Rename the doors.
Which doors should I rename, and to what pattern? For example: every door on Level 2, or every door in the model, using a pattern like L2-D01.
Upload the hospital model to the shared project.

The upload didn't finish because the file is 2.4 GB and the shared project limit is 2 GB. Your local model is unchanged. You can purge unused elements or detach linked models, then retry. Want me to check what's taking up the most space?
Run clash detection between MEP and structure on Level 3.

content.worst: Duct D-114 passes through beam B-22

turns.content: I found 14 clashes on Level 3: 9 ducts through beams and 5 pipes through columns. The worst is duct D-114 passing through beam B-22. Want me to group them by system so you can assign them?
What fire rating do the corridor walls on Level 2 need?

I can't confirm that from the model. Corridor ratings depend on occupancy, sprinklers and the code edition your jurisdiction adopted, and the project doesn't have a code edition set. The project info lists a sprinklered I-2 occupancy. Check the required rating with your code consultant or the local code official, and I can then find walls on Level 2 that don't match it.
Export sheets A101 through A110 to PDF.
Done! Sheets A101 through A110 are exported to PDF and saved in your Exports folder.
Summarize RFI 42 for me.

Make the stairs comply.

Which requirement should the stairs meet? I can check riser height, tread depth, headroom or handrails against values you give me. Those limits come from the code your jurisdiction adopted, so confirm them with the local code official or your code consultant first.
¿Cómo cambio las unidades del proyecto a métricas?

Según el artículo de ayuda «Unidades del proyecto»: selecciona Administrar > Unidades del proyecto y, en Longitud, elige milímetros o metros. El cambio se aplica a todas las vistas. ¿Quieres que lo cambie por ti?

This view renders at Best quality, 600 DPI, with 212 lights on. For draft renders, select Medium quality, lower the resolution, and turn off lights that aren't in the lobby.
